title: Core Warlock Traits
contents: text | Hit Point DieD8 per Warlock level

title: Quest for Knowledge
contents: text | Warlocks pursue forbidden knowledge hidden within the multiverse, often found in ancient tomes or whispered through eldritch invocations.
text | Their arcane journey leads to a binding pact with extraplanar patrons such as angels, archfey, devils, hags, or entities of the Far Realm.
text | Patrons serve as both resource and master: some Warlocks show reverence, others obey reluctantly, and a few conspire to twist the pact.
text | Once bound, the Warlock is driven by a thirst for arcane power and a hunger for cosmic truth, often pursued through adventure.

title: Becoming a Warlock
contents: bullet | Gain all the traits in the Core Warlock Traits table.
bullet | Gain the Warlock’s level 1 features (see Warlock Features table).
bullet | Gain Hit Die (D8) and light armor from Core Traits.
bullet | Gain Warlock level 1 features; see multiclassing rules for spell slots.

title: Eldritch Invocations
contents: text | You learn one Invocation of your choice (e.g. Pact of the Tome). Invocations grant magical abilities or lessons.
description | Prerequisites | You must meet an invocation’s prerequisites (e.g. Warlock level 5 to learn certain invocations).
description | Replacing & Gaining | When you level up, you can swap one Invocation for another you qualify for. You gain more Invocations at specified levels.
text | You can’t pick the same Invocation twice unless its description allows it.

title: Pact Magic
contents: text | Through occult ceremony you form a pact to cast spells. See chapter 7 for general spellcasting rules.
text | Cantrips: You know two warlock cantrips (Eldritch Blast, Prestidigitation recommended). Swap one when you level up.
text | At warlock levels 4 & 10 you learn an additional cantrip (per Cantrips column in Features table).

title: Warlock Starting Equipment
contents: text | You may choose one of the following equipment packages to begin your journey as a Warlock.
text | Book (occult lore), scholar’s pack2 daggers15 gp
text | 100 gp, to spend as you see fit on starting equipment.

title: Magical Cunning
contents: text | You can perform an esoteric rite for 1 minute. At the end of it, you regain expended Pact Magic spell slots, up to half your maximum (rounded up).
text | Once used, this feature can’t be used again until you finish a Long Rest.

title: Warlock Subclass
contents: text | Choose a Warlock subclass (e.g. Archfey, Celestial, Fiend, or Great Old One).
text | A subclass grants features as you level up. You gain all subclass features at levels you reach, as listed in its description.

title: Ability Score Improvement
contents: text | You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or any feat you qualify for.
text | You gain this feature again at Warlock levels 8, 12, and 16.

title: Contact Patron
contents: text | You always have Contact Other Plane prepared.
text | You can cast it once without a spell slot to contact your patron and automatically succeed on the saving throw.
text | You regain use after a Long Rest.

title: Mystic Arcanum
contents: text | Choose a level 6 Warlock spell as your Mystic Arcanum. Cast it once without a spell slot per Long Rest.
text | At levels 13, 15, and 17, choose one additional Warlock spell of levels 7, 8, and 9 respectively.
text | Replace one arcanum spell with another of same level when you gain a Warlock level.

title: Epic Boon
contents: text | You gain an Epic Boon feat or any feat for which you qualify.

title: Eldritch Master
contents: text | When you use Magical Cunning, you now regain all expended Pact Magic spell slots.

text | Your mastery of arcane forces reaches its peak. When you use Magical Cunning, the eldritch knowledge channeled through your patron allows you to recover all expended Pact Magic spell slots, rather than just one.
text | This surge of power reflects your perfected bond with the arcane, granting you supreme flexibility and readiness in battle.

title: Pact of the Blade
contents: text | As a Bonus Action, conjure or bond with a Simple or Martial Melee weapon. Use it as a Spellcasting Focus.
text | You can use your Charisma modifier for attack and damage rolls, and choose to deal Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, or normal damage.
text | Bond ends if you use this feature again, the weapon is >5 ft away for 1+ min, or you die.
footer | Warlock | Pact Boon | Blade Bond

title: Pact of the Chain
contents: text | Learn Find Familiar. Cast it without a spell slot as a Magic Action.
text | Familiar can be a special form: Imp, Pseudodragon, Quasit, Skeleton, Slaad Tadpole, Sphinx of Wonder, Sprite, Venomous Snake.
text | When you Attack, you can let your familiar attack using its Reaction.

title: Pact of the Tome
contents: text | Conjure a Book of Shadows at end of a Short/Long Rest. It vanishes if you conjure another or die.
text | Choose 3 cantrips + 2 level 1 ritual spells from any class. While on your person, you have them prepared as Warlock spells.
text | The book is a Spellcasting Focus.
